steps.text: Bread (55/70 g) toasted properly — dark, not pale. It has to hold.
Dressing: yoghurt (40/50 g), oil (4/5 g, olive — dressing), lemon, ½ tsp mustard, black pepper, salt.
Avocado (45/60 g) mashed onto one slice with lemon and salt.
Sunday's chicken (110/145 g — 255 g total, of the ~760 g roast batch) sliced thin and tossed in the dressing.
Build: avocado, chicken, cheddar (12/16 g), tomato (70/90 g) salted, and lettuce (50/60 g) LAST, against the top slice.
Press under a plate for 2 minutes. Cut on the diagonal.

why: Lettuce against the top slice, tomato salted and buried in the middle. Tomato against bread makes it wet within minutes; a leaf of lettuce is a waterproof layer, and it is the only reason a sandwich made in the morning survives to lunchtime.
notes: D0-003: oil is entirely a raw dressing (mixed into the cold yoghurt dressing, never heated) — stays olive_oil, unchanged.
Lettuce substitution NOT applied: the why-text explicitly says 'a leaf of lettuce is a waterproof layer' — definitively whole-leaf, not shredded. Stays lettuce.
